messages:
anna: Quick follow-up from the cache-thrash postmortem — we agreed to refresh the escalation cookbook and add explicit triage commands. I sketched a first pass below, need owners and timelines.

mike: SGTM. Can you paste the sketch?

anna: Sure — here's the proposed triage flow we should add to the cookbook:
1) Detect: check Redis memory/evictions and request surge metrics.
2) Short-term mitigation: enable read-only cache tier, scale up replica count if available.
3) Fix: identify hot prefixes, add prefix-aware eviction or TTL, roll config.
4) Postmortem: capture request traces and frequency.

anna: Commands to include (put verbatim into the cookbook):
```bash
# check redis memory and evictions
redis-cli INFO memory | egrep "used_memory_human|evicted_keys"
# list top keys by size (requires rdbtools or redis-cli + scan)
redis-cli --scan | xargs -n1 redis-cli MEMORY USAGE | sort -nr | head -n 20
# in k8s, check pod OOMs and restarts
kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=cache -o wide; kubectl describe pod <pod>
```

sophie: Nice. I can own the cookbook PR. I'll also add a tiny playbook section about when to flip to the warm fallback model (our mid-tier region). ETA?

anna: Thanks @sophie. Can you do the PR by EOD Thu? We want this in the runbook before the next oncall rotation.

raj: I'll handle validation — I'll run the commands on staging and write a short test checklist (how to simulate the hot prefix with a load generator). ETA Fri morning.

leah: For escalation paths: currently page escalation goes to oncall -> infra -> eng-sre. Proposing we add an explicit step: if evicted_keys > 0 and 95th p99 latency > 300ms for >5m, escalate to infra lead and signal for capacity bump. Add contact matrix in the cookbook.

mike: Also add a fallback policy: auto-burst to dedicated nodes for 10m + notify slack and create incident ticket. That's in line with the SLA fallback policy.

anna: Ownership summary: cookbook PR owner = sophie (EOD Thu), validation owner = raj (Fri AM), escalation matrix owner = leah (please add contacts + notification templates). I'll file the follow-up actions in the postmortem tracker after this thread.

incident-bot: Reminder queued: follow-up check-in in 7 days (1767148010) for thread 1766543210.

sophie: Starting the PR now. I'll add the commands exactly as posted and a short troubleshooting checklist. Will tag @raj for validation. :raised_hands:

raj: FYI I'll create a small load script and a k8s job to simulate the hot prefix and post results in the PR.

mike: One more note — let's add a short canary runbook step: after applying TTL/eviction changes, run a 30m canary on 5% traffic, monitor evictions and latency, rollback criteria spelled out.

anna: Perfect. If everyone hits the dates above we'll close the action items in the postmortem board next Monday sprint check. Thanks all.
